# 付费行动：共享资格、执行与界面绑定

[API 任务入口](../../index.md) · [公开模块](../index.md)

`CountryAction(id, spec)` 将一项国家行动的资格条件、政治点数成本与执行效果写在一起。`politicalPowerCost` 是非负安全整数，`available` 是可选资格条件，`perform` 描述成功执行后的效果。返回句柄的 `.available` 可传给 `country.test`，`.execute` 可传给 `country.run`；两者都是普通的国家作用域 scripted handle。

`.available` 同时检查资格与余额；`.execute` 在执行时再次检查，扣除一次费用，再调用 `perform`。这保证按钮显示后状态发生变化时也按当前条件执行。ScriptedWindow 的国家上下文按钮可直接写 `action={handle}`，此时不再同时填写 `click` / `enabled`。

决议使用 `action: handle` 绑定同一行动，费用由游戏原生决议机制扣除，资格与执行体分别复用。行动决议不再同时填写 `cost` / `available` / `completeEffect`，仍可设置可见性、持续时间等其他决议字段。下方将构造器、输入和句柄放在同一页，普通决议字段可从[决议参考](decisions.md)继续查看。

## 使用示例

```ts
import { CountryAction, CountryEvent, Decision, DecisionCategory } from "krieg-lang/hoi4";

const aid = CountryAction("recovery_aid", {
  politicalPowerCost: 25,
  available: country => !country.triggers.hasCountryFlag("aid_received"),
  perform: country => {
    country.effects.addStability(0.05);
    country.effects.setCountryFlag("aid_received");
  },
});

DecisionCategory({ id: "reconstruction_office", decisions: [
  Decision({ id: "fund_relief", action: aid }),
] });

CountryEvent({ id: "relief.1", hidden: true, isTriggeredOnly: true,
  immediate: country => country.run(aid.execute),
});
```

## CountryAction() { #countryaction }

> **CountryAction**&lt;`Id` *extends* `string`&gt;(`id`: `Id`, `spec`: [`CountryActionSpec`](#countryactionspec)): [`CountryActionDefinition`](#countryactiondefinition)&lt;`Id`&gt;

Defined in: [src/sdk/gameplay.ts:46](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/gameplay.ts#L46)

Declare reusable eligibility, price and settlement for a country action.

### Type Parameters { #countryaction-section-type-parameters }

| Type Parameter |
| ------ |
| <a id="countryaction-type-parameter-id"></a> `Id` *extends* `string` |

### Parameters { #countryaction-section-parameters }

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `id` | `Id` |
| `spec` | [`CountryActionSpec`](#countryactionspec) |

### Returns { #countryaction-section-returns }

[`CountryActionDefinition`](#countryactiondefinition)&lt;`Id`&gt;

### Remarks { #countryaction-section-remarks }

Buttons use `action={aid}`. Events use `country.run(aid.execute)`;
an optional display condition is `country.test(aid.available)`. Decisions use
`{ id: "request_aid", action: aid }` and cannot override cost, available or
completeEffect. Ordinary decisions pay through native cost and call settlement
directly, without checking the already-deducted balance or charging again.
Generated names are `${id}_eligible`, `${id}_available`, `${id}_perform` and
`${id}_execute`; these names are reserved against other scripted declarations.

## CountryActionDefinition&lt;Id *extends* `string` = `string`&gt; { #countryactiondefinition }

Defined in: [src/sdk/gameplay.ts:27](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/gameplay.ts#L27)

A compiler-created paid country action, reusable across modules and entry points.

### Remarks { #countryactiondefinition-section-remarks }

`available` includes eligibility and affordability. `execute` rechecks
both in native if/limit, deducts the price once, then runs the shared settlement.
Bind the action directly to a decision so the game's cost system collects the price.
